Title: Rohan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Rohan - 9 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Anita - 41 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Rajesh - 37 years, father
Look: light beard, green T-shirt

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rohan stands in the courtyard. Anita and Rajesh stand near him.]

Rajesh: "Let's do something fun today."

[Rohan bursts out laughing.]

Rohan: "Hmm, I see."

[Rohan starts crying.]

Rohan: "Yes, all right."

[Rohan smiles at Mother.]

Rohan: "I'm ready!"

Scene 2: The road - Day

Anita: "So, here we are!"

[Rohan rides his bicycle down the road.]

Rohan: "One more time!"

[Rohan gets into the car.]

Rohan: "One more time!"

[Rohan gets on the bus.]

Rajesh: "Let's see."

[Rohan gets off the school bus.]

Rohan: "Oh wow!"

[Rohan hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Rohan: "I really enjoyed today."
